title: pellaea glauca
intro: Pellaea glauca, commonly known as Blue Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, thereby helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea glauca are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full scope of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
